stories.title: ‎Saudi Construction Cost Index rises 2.3% in August

en.title: Saudi Construction Cost Index rises 2.3% in August
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Construction Cost Index increased 2.3% year-on-year in August 2026, reaching 104 points. The rise was driven by increased costs in both residential and non-residential construction sectors.
